accounting.title: Accounting Services
accounting.shortDescription: Comprehensive accounting services ensuring accuracy, transparency, and full compliance with Armenian legislation.
accounting.description:
We provide comprehensive accounting services, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and full compliance of your business's financial records with the legislation of the Republic of Armenia.

Our team manages all stages of accounting, from the preparation of primary documentation to the compilation and submission of tax, statistical, and financial reports. We work with both small and large organizations, offering tailored and effective solutions that meet each client's specific needs.

With us, your business accounting is maintained in a secure, transparent, and fully controlled environment.
features: Complete accounting and bookkeeping service
Reduction and control of tax risks
Timely preparation and submission of reports
Preparation and maintenance of HR documentation
Ensuring regulatory compliance
Professional consulting and support
whyImportant: Full organization of accounting and tax processes
Reduction and control of tax risks
Operations compliant with the requirements of Armenian legislation
Reliable professional support at every stage of your business
targetAudience: Everyone looking for a reliable accounting partner
advantages: A team of qualified and experienced professionals
Full compliance with the requirements of Armenian legislation

tax.title: Tax Advisory
tax.shortDescription: Professional tax advisory to help you make well-grounded decisions and ensure your business's financial stability.
tax.description:
We provide comprehensive tax advisory services aimed at the accurate planning of your business's tax obligations and the lawful optimization of the tax burden.

Our specialists work with both small and large businesses, helping to establish a stable, transparent, and predictable tax framework in full compliance with the legislation of the Republic of Armenia.

If you wish to maintain a controlled tax environment and be confident in the future of your business, contact us and receive a free initial consultation.
features: Analysis and planning of tax obligations
Selection of the appropriate tax regime
Assessment and prevention of tax risks
Preparation for and support during tax audits
Review and advisory support on tax reporting
Professional assistance in tax disputes
advantages: Deep knowledge of Armenian tax law

hr.title: HR Administration and Documentation
hr.shortDescription: Complete HR administration services ensuring proper employment relations and labor law compliance.
hr.description:
We provide comprehensive HR administration and documentation services, ensuring proper management of employment relations and full compliance with the labor legislation of the Republic of Armenia.

We support employers throughout all HR processes, including employee hiring, termination, working time tracking, and preparation of all mandatory HR documentation, while minimizing legal and administrative risks.
features: Drafting and execution of employment contracts
Documentation of employee hiring, transfers, and termination
Tracking of working hours and leave records
Preparation of HR documentation related to payroll
Maintenance and archiving of personnel records
Advisory services on labor law matters
whyImportant: Protect both employer and employee rights
advantages: Expert knowledge of Armenian labor law

payroll.title: Payroll Calculation
payroll.shortDescription: Complete payroll calculation services ensuring accurate calculations, compliance with legal requirements, and timely execution.
payroll.description:
Accurate and timely payroll management is one of the most critical responsibilities of any organization. We offer comprehensive payroll accounting services, ensuring precise calculations, legal compliance, and complete reporting.

Our goal is to relieve you from complex calculations and provide a clear and transparent payroll process for your employees.

By entrusting payroll management to us, you save time, reduce risks, and ensure the financial stability of your business.
features: Payroll calculation based on employment contracts
Calculation and accounting of personal income tax
Calculation of social contributions and mandatory deductions
Calculation of vacation pay and sick leave benefits
Accounting for allowances, bonuses, and compensations
Preparation of payroll statements
Preparation of payroll-related reports
Advisory services on payroll calculation matters
targetAudience: Businesses seeking to outsource payroll processing
advantages: Full compliance with labor and tax legislation

financial.title: Financial Advisory
financial.shortDescription: We help you assess financial indicators, identify growth opportunities, and make effective business decisions.
financial.description:
Financial advisory is the cornerstone of your business's stable and efficient development. Through professional financial management, you can reduce risks, optimize costs, and make well-grounded business decisions.

We offer financial advisory services tailored to the specific characteristics of your organization and fully aligned with the legislative requirements of the Republic of Armenia.

Through financial advisory, we help you gain a comprehensive view of your business's financial position and choose the most effective paths for sustainable growth.
features: Analysis of financial statements
Assessment of the company's financial condition
Revenue and expense planning
Budgeting and financial forecasting
Advisory on tax burden optimization
Effective cash flow management
Financial analysis of investment projects
Assessment and mitigation of financial risks
whyImportant: Stay prepared for market and legislative changes
targetAudience: Organizations seeking to improve financial management

audit.title: Internal Audit
audit.shortDescription: We assess your organization's internal control system, identify risks, and offer effective solutions for the sustainable development of your business.
audit.description:
Internal audit is a key tool for controlling an organization's financial and operational processes. It helps identify risks, prevent errors and misconduct, and enhance business efficiency and financial discipline.

We offer professional internal audit services, providing objective assessments and practical recommendations to support your organization's sustainable development.

Through internal audit, you gain a clear understanding of your business's financial position and effective tools to reduce risks and ensure sustainable growth.
features: Review of the accounting system
Assessment of compliance of financial statements
Identification of tax risks
Analysis of internal control mechanisms
Review of document management processes
Verification of payroll calculations and payments
Assessment of financial and operational risks
Preparation of an audit report with recommendations
whyImportant: Detect accounting errors in a timely manner
Be prepared for external inspections and audits
targetAudience: Organizations preparing for tax audits or external audits

review.title: Accounting Review and Correction
review.shortDescription: We review accounting data, correct identified discrepancies, and restore the accuracy of your bookkeeping.
review.description:
Accounting review and correction is a crucial step in ensuring financial accuracy, legal compliance, and the safe development of a business. Errors or omissions may lead to tax risks, penalties, and financial losses.

We provide professional accounting review and correction services, ensuring full restoration and proper organization of your accounting system.

By entrusting this process to us, you receive clear, accurate, and well-organized accounting without unnecessary risks or concerns.
features: Review of accounting documentation
Assessment of the accuracy of accounting records
Review of tax reports and filings
Identification of errors and inconsistencies
Correction of accounting data
Recovery of missing or incomplete records
Assessment of tax risks
Advisory support for proper accounting going forward
whyImportant: Be prepared for tax and external audits
targetAudience: Businesses that have changed their accountant
Organizations preparing for a tax audit
Start-up companies requiring initial accounting setup
advantages: Full compliance with tax and accounting legislation

reporting.title: Financial Reporting Preparation
reporting.shortDescription: We prepare reliable and complete financial statements for management and decision-making.
reporting.description:
Accurate and timely preparation of financial statements is the foundation of transparency and reliability of an organization's financial position. Precise financial reports are essential both for effective management decision-making and for proper cooperation with regulatory authorities and business partners.

We provide professional financial reporting preparation services in full compliance with the requirements of the legislation of the Republic of Armenia and applicable accounting standards.

Professionally prepared financial statements help you accurately assess your business's financial position and make well-informed decisions.
features: Structuring and summarizing accounting data
Preparation of the balance sheet
Preparation of profit and loss statements
Preparation of cash flow statements
Preparation of statements of changes in equity
Preparation of interim and annual financial statements
Verification of the accuracy of financial reports
Advisory support on the use and interpretation of financial reports
whyImportant: Obtain a true picture of the organization's financial position
Ensure accuracy and reliability of financial statements
Be prepared for tax, banking, and external audits
Enhance credibility with partners and investors
targetAudience: Organizations required to submit financial statements to banks or investors
advantages: Full compliance with accounting and tax legislation
